# Pinned Rust dependency licenses

Generated from the locked wasm32 dependency graph. Includes build/development dependencies as well as runtime crates. Paths to private build machines are deliberately excluded. Full retained license/notice texts are in `texts/`; Cargo.lock records immutable sources and checksums. Upstream source remains available through its registry/Git source.
